sourceIssues: The explanation's legal basis could not be checked against the primary source. It relies on 解釈 Art. 29 (Table 29-1: machinery at 300V or below → D-type earthing; low voltage above 300V → C-type) and Art. 17 Para. 3 and 4 (C-type 10Ω and D-type 100Ω, each relaxed to 500Ω with automatic disconnection within 0.5 s). The supplied official local excerpt (20231226-2.pdf, SHA256=7ff56485…) covers only pp.31–32 (Art. 17 Para. 1 A-type and Para. 2 B-type) and pp.44–45 (Art. 36 Para. 3 onward and Art. 37), not those provisions. WebFetch of the original URL and of METI's commentary PDFs (dengikaishakukaisetsu.pdf, 280401-3-4.pdf) all returned 403. Add a pinned excerpt of Art. 17 Para. 3–4 and Art. 29.
assessment.verifiedEvidence: Official question PDF, p.15 lighting panel diagram: ⑥ points to the earthing electrode at the end of the E5.5 earth wire (⑯). The supply is 1φ3W 100/200V and the main breaker is 'B 3P100A' (not an earth-leakage breaker). The question text states there is no earth-fault disconnection device on the supply side of the service drop. Official answer: Q36 = ハ. The official local excerpt pp.31–32 confirms only Art. 17 Para. 1 (A-type: 10Ω or less) and Para. 2 (B-type); it does not contain the D-type or Art. 29 provisions.
